amendments.correction: The generator now builds each case from the class's real constructor signature, supplying every argument without a default plus every field the requirement reads, and verifies the case by constructing the object and reading each required field. String values are drawn from a fixed disclosed ladder of generic shapes -- an identifier, an absolute path, a content-addressed reference -- and the first combination the class accepts is kept. An entry no generated case can build is excluded and recorded with its reason, because an entry that measures nothing can neither qualify nor refute.
amendments.defect: The pool frozen on 18 August 2026 carried hidden cases synthesised from a seed and never run. Each case assigned only the fields its requirement mentioned, not the arguments the constructor required, so seven of the nine entries raised on construction: AgentResult, EpisodeOutcome, SkillDemonstration, ContainerSpec, StructuredModelPolicy, ModelRequest and TeacherCallTrap. Only ContainerLimits and HarborEpisodeLimits could be built. The draw for the adopted mechanism selected TeacherCallTrap and ContainerSpec, both broken, so a run would have reported a failed qualification that was an artifact of the instrument rather than a fact about the mechanism.
amendments.disclosure: The regenerated draw selects ContainerLimits and ModelRequest, whose requirements both bind keys matching their fields. The re-keyed requirements -- ContainerSpec's destination<-working_directory and TeacherCallTrap's teacher_calls<-calls -- remain in the pool but are not what this draw exercises.

entries_excluded.reason: the class is an Enum, so it has no constructor fields to render

amendments.found_before: any qualification, result or register claim existed
amendments.title: the qualification pool's hidden cases were never executed
amendments.what_did_not_change: The hypothesis, the conditions, the falsifiers, the arms, the eligible component set, the draw rule, the number of entries drawn, the number of hidden cases per requirement, and the diagnosis and synthesis mechanisms. The adopted mechanism digest is unchanged at 3cd1314f4ed0fea0016d3dc9c85faec21b3fe12fbdcf26cdad896c24cc639214.
amendments.why_it_was_not_caught: tests/test_m094_qualification_pool.py asserted that a case must assign exactly the fields its requirement reads and no others, which is the assertion that made the defect mandatory. Nothing executed a case until the qualification harness did.
amendments.why_this_is_not_a_repair_after_the_fact: No qualification, result or register claim existed when the defect was found, and none exists now. The correction is to the instrument, not to a verdict, and it is recorded here permanently rather than absorbed -- the standard D-M076 set: a defect found before materialization is corrected in the open with its arithmetic. The draw moved because entry digests moved, and the generation was run once; the draw it produced was not inspected before the pool was accepted.

design_audit.corrected_measure_p5_defect_and_repair: RenderAsMapping.min_fields was authored, and sweeping it over 2-6 moved the selected component on three of five values. The declared value 3 was the outlier: 2, 4 and 5 all selected mira_core/contracts.py. Disclosed as Defect 5 rather than repaired by choosing the tidiest threshold, then repaired properly by removing the constant. Attribution now asks how many reachable classes could explain a call site: exactly one is evidence about that class, several is evidence about none. Nothing is sweepable, P5 passes, and the earlier selection of mira_core/safety.py is withdrawn as an artifact of the constant rather than a finding.

admissible_observations: the abstract syntax tree of the component
the public names the component defines
the call sites of the component elsewhere in the repository
the results of executing the component against its own existing tests
forbidden_observations: any string keyed to a single component path
any authored per-component weight, rank or ordering

eligible_components.no_component_may_be_unreachable: for every eligible component there must exist an admissible observation under which it is selected; an eligible component that no observation can select is excluded from the set rather than left as a decorative alternative

falsifiers: an insufficiency indicator matches exactly one eligible component
an insufficiency indicator is a substring of the repair it motivates
the diagnostic reports a capability missing from a component that defines it
supplying the capability does not change the diagnostic verdict
an eligible component cannot be selected under any admissible observation
the selected component is determined by an authored severity constant rather than a measured property
the selected component moves when an authored constant of the measure is swept over its admissible range
the transformation set contains the adopted repair as a finished body
the transformation set contains a branch on a component name or path
the transformation set holds one element, so no search occurs
the repair is obtained by parameterising an authored patch rather than by composing operations
the qualification requirement is reachable by the development component's repair unchanged
a qualifying requirement exists in a module the lineage imports before adoption
the validator encodes the expected repair
the validator and the generator share authorship of the acceptance criterion
more budget over the same operation set reaches the requirement
a random component selection reaches the requirement
the rollback fault strikes a detached copy rather than the live file
an external model is called during the scientific run
the recorded attempt provenance disagrees with the preserved artifacts
a real defect in the system is corrected after the verdict in order to save the result

hypothesis.registered_status: REGISTERED and FROZEN as an open question in SCIENTIFIC_HYPOTHESES.md. Not supported: no qualification run has been performed.
hypothesis.statement: A lineage can locate the component that limits it and construct the repair, without being told which component to change or what the change is.

not_a_reattempt_of_m092: M094 does not re-run, modify or claim anything about M092's protocol, search, salt or partial segments. H38 and D062 remain unresolved and are not touched. M094 has its own hypothesis, protocol, substrate, qualification, checker and result.

predecessors.M047: the transformation, sandbox and adoption machinery reused here; not re-litigated
predecessors.M093: engineering rehearsal. Its TARGET_FILE, diagnostic, capability choice and patch body were authored, and it says so. M094 attacks exactly those four and nothing else.

qualification.cross_component: the requirement must be satisfied on a component other than the one used during development, so that a repair mechanism specialised to the development component fails
qualification.draw_rule: Order entries by sha256(entry_digest + adopted mechanism digest) and take the first two whose components differ. The mechanism digest does not exist until adoption, so the draw cannot be known at this freeze.
qualification.drawn_by: a separate process, with a salt derived from the adopted mechanism's own digest, which does not exist until adoption
qualification.experimenter_blindness_is_not_claimed: The pool of candidate requirements is authored and committed at this freeze, and the draw is a deterministic function of the adopted mechanism's digest, so it is reproducible by anyone. What is claimed is that the lineage cannot import, read or reach any of it before adoption. No claim is made that the experimenter was blind to the pool.

repair_substrate.assembly_is_not_selection: the set contains no finished repair. A candidate is a composition of operations plus a target region; most compositions are ill-formed, inert, or compute what the component already computes.

status_note: Frozen by the project owner on 18 August 2026, before any qualification data existed. The eligible component set is enumerated above and the qualification pool is committed at experiments/M094/QUALIFICATION_POOL.json with digest 44f46e6b92996e14. No RESULT.json, QUALIFICATION.json or REGISTER_CLAIM.json exists at this freeze. From here the protocol may not be repaired to save a result: a correction after a verdict is forbidden, superseded runs are preserved and disclosed, and the attempt number is derived from the preserved artifacts rather than declared. Amended on 19 August 2026 by amendment A1, recorded in full above and permanently: the qualification pool's hidden cases were synthesised and never executed, and seven of nine entries raised on construction. The pool was regenerated with every case verified by construction and the superseded pool preserved. No qualification, result or register claim existed before, during or after the amendment, and the adopted mechanism is unchanged.
subtitle: The lineage chooses what to repair, and builds the repair
title: Autonomous Component Diagnosis and Repair Synthesis

two_capabilities_required.A: diagnosis: the limited component is located by measurement over admissible observations, and a rival component would have been selected had the measurement differed
two_capabilities_required.B: synthesis: the repair is composed from operations none of which contains it, and it satisfies a requirement drawn after the mechanism was fixed

verdict_rule: positive iff every condition is true; each is computed and each can fail
